To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the incorporation of fish oil in konja glucomannan gel significantly (P<0,001) reduced the fat content of Spanish salchichon (30.4%), but also increased the lipid oxidation (P<0,.05).
the partial substitution of pork fat by microencapsulatted fish oil in Spanish salchichon improved the lipid profile of this traditional meat product.
the partial replacement of pork backfat with microencapsulate fish oil in konjag matrix can be used to produce a healthy Spanish salchichon with better lipid content and composition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and characterization of a new product, a Spanish salchichon with a high content of n-3 fatty acid, which can be used in a healthy diet.
the development of a healthy product, with a high nutritional value, which could contribute to reduce the incidence of cardiovascular diseases and other chronic degenerative diseases.
the production and characterization of a novel functional sausage enriched with n-3 long-chain fatty acids from fish oils.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of microcapsules of n-3 fatty acid from fish oil into the konjac glucomanannan matrix is a promising approach to improve the lipid content of Spanish salchichon.

the reformulation of salchichón using microencapsulated oil in konjac matrix is a feasible strategy for reducing the fat content of the final product, improving the n-3 fatty acid content, and increasing the lipid oxidation.
it is possible to develop a Spanish salchichon with a better lipid profile by partial replacement of pork backfat with fish oil microencapsulated in konjac gluco-mannan matrix.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible to produce a healthy salchichón, which is rich in n-3 fatty acid and low in fat content, by partial replacement of pork backfat with encapsulated fish oil.
it is feasible to develop Spanish sausage enriched with microencapped n-3 fatty acid from fish oil.
the incorporation of fish oil microencapsulated in konjac glucommannan matrix in Spanish salchichon is possible, but it should be accompanied by the incorporation of antioxidants to avoid oxidation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the incorporation of encapsulated fish oil in the Spanish salchichon is a feasible strategy to improve the lipid content and fatty acid composition, and thus the quality of this product.
it is possible to develop Spanish salamí-type sausages with a high content of PUFA (n-3) by replacing a significant proportion of pork backfat with microencapsulate fish oil.

the use of konjac glucomanan gel as a fat replacer in the formulation of sausages is an alternative strategy to improve the fatty acid composition of the sausages and, consequently, the healthiness of the product.
